fullPassage: Gregg and I had been rock climbing since sunrise and had had no problems. So we took a risk. "Look, the first bolt is right there. I can definitely climb out to it. Piece of cake," I persuaded Gregg, minutes before I found myself pinned. It wasn't a piece of cake. The rock was deceptively barren of handholds. I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face and ended up with nowhere to go... but down. The bolt that would save my life, if I could get to it, was about two feet above my reach. My arms trembled from exhaustion. I looked at Gregg. My body froze with fright from my neck down to my toes. Our rope was tied between us. If I fell, he would fall with me.

I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face and ended up with nowhere to go... but down. The bolt that would save my life, if I could get to it, was about two feet above my reach. My arms trembled from exhaustion. I looked at Gregg. My body froze with fright from my neck down to my toes. Our rope was tied between us. If I fell, he would fall with me.

det.korean: 과신으로 위기에 처한 등반가의 절박한 상황이 주제
det.analysis:
❌ ① 장비 소개: 본문에 없음
❌ ② 코스 고르는 법: 본문에 없음
✅ ③ 과신으로 위험에 처한 암벽 등반가의 절박한 상황: 'Piece of cake'라 장담했다가 꼼짝 못 하게 된 위기 ← 정답
❌ ④ 우정의 중요성: 핵심 주제 아님

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과신한 무리한 도전이 위기를 부른다는 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 혼자 등반: 본문은 둘이 묶여 더 위험
❌ ② 볼트 장비: 요지 아님
❌ ③ 일출 등반: 요지 아님
✅ ④ 과신에 기반한 무리한 도전은 생명을 위협하는 위기를 부를 수 있다: 'Piece of cake'라 장담한 과신이 생사의 위기로 이어짐 ← 정답
